# exp13 XML artifact adapter — prepared only

No VM or PHP execution has occurred in this phase. The adapter reuses the reviewed
XML lifecycle corpus unchanged: 38 primary cases and two instrumented causal
callback-throw controls. Exp12 supplies the five baseline full-source files;
actual exp13 ZIP supplies six candidate files, including the new policy helper.
Every joined byte must equal its previously tested held-source hash. The helper
is read from the actual ZIP, **not regenerated** from a patch or local tree.

Exp13 SHA256: `6d0bc4947207e6c5457b7843948d263aa8d5f251480e58cbf9086c0add79a944`.
[Preparation/source joins](evidence/exp13-xml/preparation.json) pins both artifacts,
two immutable stage manifests, source closures, probes, synthetic WSDL fixtures,
wrapper and the same previously verified fixture-private SOAP provider. Provider
availability and every module/library hash must still pass on the VM; no install
or shared PHP configuration mutation is authorized by this adapter.

Only runner stage/phase names change. Its read-only sandbox, denied sockets,
private temp, E_ALL and stderr diagnostics remain unchanged. The collectors compare
complete native stdout/stderr against the historically reviewed corpus, including
baseline diagnostic defects and the causal finding: ext/soap turns the thrown
RuntimeException into SoapFault without a previous chain. Raw byte channels are
retained before validation. Any new diagnostic/output differs and fails visibly.
Six local adapter tests replay retained observations and rejection controls;
these are not new native execution evidence.

Frozen probes still emit `application_patch_selected:false`: this historical
fixture field is preserved byte-for-byte, **not** a claim that exp13 has not been
selected for its lab experiment. Stage metadata explicitly identifies the selected
artifact; application acceptance remains false. The transport seam only overrides
`__doRequest` with a synthetic envelope; no real HTTP/backend/full bootstrap scope.

## Deferred execution, exclusive native83 required

```sh
python3 tools/php83/exp13-xml/stage.py
python3 doc/php83/evidence/exp10-runtime/snapshot-php83.py doc/php83/evidence/exp13-xml/primary-before.json
python3 tools/php83/exp13-xml/collect.py doc/php83/evidence/exp13-xml/primary.json
python3 doc/php83/evidence/exp10-runtime/snapshot-php83.py doc/php83/evidence/exp13-xml/primary-after.json
```

Fresh remote stages refuse existing directories. Actual independent repeat uses
new report names and the same immutable stage; no shared VM writers. Parent owns
lab allocation after compiler/API priority. No rollback, deployment or release
acceptance follows from source equality or adapter guards.

## Prep review and reproducibility correction

Actual Claude initial local review ran five guards and both shell syntax checks
successfully, with no runtime execution. Its two concrete observations are retained:
invalid-UTF8 stdout could lose raw stderr, and historical /tmp staging inputs were
not durable. A separate local correction captures both raw byte channels first.
Only historical manifests, synthetic fixtures and public provider hash metadata
are now retained in `reference/`; source comes from the two ZIPs and frozen probes
from the existing tracked corpus. A fresh local preparation reproduced both stage
manifest hashes exactly. The old collector/preparer are retained in reviewed-r1.

To reconstruct ignored staging on a fresh checkout with the two pinned ZIPs:

```sh
python3 tools/php83/exp13-xml/prepare.py \
  --exp12 ../platform-install-packages-php83-artifacts/exp12/Rigel-18.20.0-php83-experimental.exp12.zip \
  --exp13 ../platform-install-packages-php83-artifacts/exp13/Rigel-18.20.0-php83-experimental.exp13.zip \
  --output tools/php83/exp13-xml/stage
python3 tools/php83/exp13-xml/test_adapter.py
```

The output path is fixed for the reviewed runtime adapter; existing directories
are refused. No provider binary or whole application tree is committed.
